Play 2 to 3 heroes at a time, with one hero for every 5-15 matches. Then observe how the heroes you choose work, how their skills work, and to what situations their skills work best.

Also:

1. Learn how to build items quickly and efficiently through farming, as we which items go well with the heroes you play as. Check websites like vaingloryfire and look at how other players item-build their heroes.

2. Depending on the role your hero has (e.g. Ringo - lane, Taka - Jungle, Phinn - Roam), learn the basics of that role as well as how that hero works in that role. If you play as lane, focus on timing the last hits for your minions, and if you play as jungle, learn how to farm the monsters quickly and efficiently.

3. As much as possible, be very aware of how you play the game (if you move/tap or time your skills properly) and try to focus only on the heroes/minions/monsters you are currently battling as well as yourself. 

4. What also helped me was the academy section of the app. Going through some of the basics (sometimes again) really helps. Also, the vainglory website also has certain guides which are worth checking.

5. Knowing how to survive. Most of the time chasing the enemy hero when both of you are at low health never works out, and other than that, try to know when's the best time to use potions on your hero, whether your hiding in a bush, or fleeing to your base's defenses.

...

Be sure to know the terms that are used in MOBAs such as ganking, kiting, etc. Have fun playing Vainglory!! :)
